strategies.name: sma_crossover
strategies.description: Long-only SMA crossover: buy when the fast SMA is above the slow SMA, exit when it falls below.

strategies.name: macd_trend
strategies.description: MACD/EMA trend follower: buy MACD above signal and close above trend EMA; exit when both flip.

strategies.name: donchian_trend
strategies.description: Donchian channel breakout above a trend SMA; exit on a close below the channel low.

strategies.name: turtle_20
strategies.description: Simplified Turtle System 1: N-bar high breakout, shorter low exit, ATR protective stop.

strategies.name: bollinger_breakout
strategies.description: Upper Bollinger band breakout above the Ichimoku cloud; exit below the middle band.

strategies.name: kdj_cross
strategies.description: KDJ momentum: buy when J is above K and D; exit on J turning down, J below K or D, or an ATR stop.

strategies.name: rsi_oversold
strategies.description: RSI oversold dip buying above a trend SMA; exit on RSI recovery or max holding period.

strategies.name: rsi2_connors
strategies.description: RSI(2) oversold dip buying above a long SMA; exit above a short SMA.

strategies.name: ifr2
strategies.description: RSI(2) dip buying above the Ichimoku cloud; exit above the prior two highs.

strategies.name: supertrend_follow
strategies.description: Long-only Supertrend trend follower; indicator and parameters come from [indicators.trend] in config.toml.

strategies.name: vwap_reversion
strategies.description: Intraday long-only reversion to the IST-session VWAP with entry cutoff and 15:15 square-off.

strategies.name: alpha30_factor
strategies.description: Equal-weight 30 equities portfolio from NSE NIFTY200 ALPHA 30 rebalancing every 15 open trading days.

strategies.name: alpha30_low_vol
strategies.description: Alpha-30 portfolio of the 15 lowest-volatility constituents (20-day), equal-weighted, rebalanced every 15 trading days.

strategies.name: alpha30_mean_reversion
strategies.description: Alpha-30 portfolio of the 10 most oversold constituents (lowest 20-day price z-score), equal-weighted, rebalanced periodically.

strategies.name: alpha30_momentum
strategies.description: Alpha-30 portfolio of the 10 highest-momentum constituents over a 60-day window, equal-weighted, rebalanced periodically.

strategies.name: alpha30_quality
strategies.description: Equal-weight allocation across the whole Nifty200 Alpha 30 universe (no quality screening is applied), rebalanced every 29 days.

strategies.name: equal_weight
strategies.description: Equal-weight periodic rebalance of a named universe (default Nifty200 Alpha 30, every 15 trading days): exit leavers, enter joiners, trim winners and top up laggards. Keywords: alpha30, nifty200_alpha30, equal_weight, rebalancing, portfolio, multi_instrument.
